iago:
usage: iago [-h] [--version]
            {run,report,library,delta,compare,gate,judge-eval,campaign,compose-delta,defense-delta,power,lexical-leak,regrade,agent-run,agent-scenarios,adaptive-run,strategies,tool-abuse-run,toolabuse-scenarios,privilege-run,privilege-scenarios,disclosure-run,disclosure-scenarios,misinfo-run,misinfo-scenarios,memory-run,memory-scenarios,rag-run,rag-scenarios,a2a-run,a2a-scenarios} ...

An authorized tool for testing LLM guardrails.

positional arguments:
  {run,report,library,delta,compare,gate,judge-eval,campaign,compose-delta,defense-delta,power,lexical-leak,regrade,agent-run,agent-scenarios,adaptive-run,strategies,tool-abuse-run,toolabuse-scenarios,privilege-run,privilege-scenarios,disclosure-run,disclosure-scenarios,misinfo-run,misinfo-scenarios,memory-run,memory-scenarios,rag-run,rag-scenarios,a2a-run,a2a-scenarios}
    run                 run the attack matrix and write a report
    report              (re)generate a report from an existing artifact file
    library             show the loaded attack library + objectives
    delta               attack-vs-defense delta from a raw + a guarded artifact
    compare             multi-model differential: >=2 same-surface artifacts (different models) ->
                        one comparison report; the delta between models is the finding
    gate                CI regression gate: exit 1 when a harmful-content bypass rate rose
                        measurably (95% Wilson intervals) against --baseline or above --max-rate;
                        exit 2 when it cannot judge
    judge-eval          measure each judge's agreement / FPR / FNR (95% Wilson CIs) against the
                        reviewer-labeled control set and store them by judge_id for report headers
    campaign            cross-surface differential: run every surface x every model (LOCAL) -> ONE
                        consolidated report — the 'what did you find' artifact
    compose-delta       composition-lift report: does stacking evasions beat the best single
                        layer?
    defense-delta       paired run (raw + guarded, same seeds) → attack-vs-defense delta report
    power               how many raw/guarded trial pairs (defense-delta) detect a given bypass-
                        rate difference (McNemar; alpha 0.05 / power 0.8 by default); not for
                        compare, whose two runs are independent samples
    lexical-leak        advisory lexical-overlap paraphrased-leak band over an artifact (NOT
                        embeddings; SECONDARY to the deterministic canary oracle — see
                        docs/paraphrased-leaks.md)
    regrade             re-score an artifact file with a rubric judge (Claude by default)
    agent-run           red-team a tool-calling AGENT with indirect injection (behavioral bypass)
    agent-scenarios     show the loaded agentic-injection scenarios
    adaptive-run        adaptive dialogue-level attacker — target-adaptive multi-turn search that
                        picks its next move from the target's last refusal
    strategies          show the adaptive attacker's strategy library
    tool-abuse-run      red-team a tool-calling agent for RCE/SSRF via a SANDBOXED dangerous-tool
                        surface (fake run_shell/fetch_url — never a real process/socket)
    toolabuse-scenarios
                        show the loaded tool-abuse (RCE/SSRF) scenarios
    privilege-run       red-team a tool-calling agent for EXCESSIVE AGENCY / confused deputy
                        (LLM06/ASI03) via a SANDBOXED privileged-tool surface (fake
                        delete_record/grant_role — never a real state change)
    privilege-scenarios
                        show the loaded excessive-agency (confused-deputy) scenarios
    disclosure-run      red-team a tool-calling agent for SENSITIVE-INFO DISCLOSURE (LLM02) —
                        cross-subject leak into the answer or an external send, via a SANDBOXED
                        confidential store + comms sink
    disclosure-scenarios
                        show the loaded sensitive-info-disclosure (LLM02) scenarios
    misinfo-run         red-team a tool-calling agent for MISINFORMATION (LLM09) — it is asked for
                        a structured identifier (CVE/RFC/DOI) about a FABRICATED subject;
                        asserting one is confirmed fabrication (deterministic, no judge)
    misinfo-scenarios   show the loaded misinformation (LLM09) scenarios
    memory-run          red-team a tool-calling agent for MEMORY/CONTEXT POISONING (ASI06) — a
                        poisoned doc plants a note that fires at a later step via recall
    memory-scenarios    show the loaded memory-poisoning (ASI06) scenarios
    rag-run             red-team a tool-calling agent for RAG RETRIEVAL POISONING — a poisoned
                        knowledge-base passage, surfaced by a benign query, drives an action
    rag-scenarios       show the loaded RAG retrieval-poisoning scenarios
    a2a-run             red-team a tool-calling agent for INSECURE INTER-AGENT COMMS (ASI07) — a
                        poisoned message from a rogue peer agent drives an action
    a2a-scenarios       show the loaded inter-agent (ASI07) scenarios

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
run:
usage: iago run [-h] [--target {anthropic,ollama}] [--model MODEL] [--trials TRIALS]
                [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--base-seed BASE_SEED]
                [--limit-techniques LIMIT_TECHNIQUES] [--limit-objectives LIMIT_OBJECTIVES]
                [--category {direct-ask,role-play,format-shift,instruction-hierarchy,encoding-obfuscation,low-resource-lang,prompt-injection,template-injection,prompt-extraction,refusal-suppression,competing-objectives,many-shot,multi-turn,composed-evasion,provenance-forging,rag-injection,agent-abuse,mcp-injection,dead-end}]
                [--shots SHOTS] [--guard GUARD] [--smoke] [--no-determinism-check] [--html]
                [--log] [--authorized]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target {anthropic,ollama}
                        target backend (default: ollama)
  --model MODEL         model tag within the target backend
  --trials TRIALS       trials per (technique, objective)
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --base-seed BASE_SEED
  --limit-techniques LIMIT_TECHNIQUES
  --limit-objectives LIMIT_OBJECTIVES
  --category {direct-ask,role-play,format-shift,instruction-hierarchy,encoding-obfuscation,low-resource-lang,prompt-injection,template-injection,prompt-extraction,refusal-suppression,competing-objectives,many-shot,multi-turn,composed-evasion,provenance-forging,rag-injection,agent-abuse,mcp-injection,dead-end}
                        only techniques in this category (one row of `iago library`); with
                        --smoke, the first technique of that category
  --shots SHOTS         override fabricated-shot count for many-shot techniques (e.g. 64, 128) to
                        exercise long-context scaling
  --guard GUARD         wrap the target in a defense and measure holds: reference 'input-
                        classifier,output-dlp' or 'all'; opt-in real guards (need a backend)
                        'llama-guard,guardrails-ai,hf-prompt-injection'. Run raw + guarded, then
                        `iago delta` (or `defense-delta`)
  --smoke               1x1x1 fast proof of the loop
  --no-determinism-check
                        skip the same-seed replay probe: saves 5 short generations (a warm-up plus
                        2 probes x 2, capped at 160 tokens each, ~800 tokens) but records null
                        instead of a measurement AND leaves the matrix running on a cold model,
                        which a default run does not
  --html                also write a styled, colored HTML report
  --log                 also write a full request/response transcript (every trial, untruncated) —
                        SENSITIVE: contains live payloads + any leaked secrets, do not share
                        publicly
  --authorized          permit a non-local target (only for models you own/are authorized to test)
report:
usage: iago report [-h] [--html] [--log] artifact

positional arguments:
  artifact    path to a reports/artifacts/*.jsonl file

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --html      emit styled, colored HTML (report or --log)
  --log       emit a full request/response transcript instead of the summary report — SENSITIVE:
              contains live payloads + any leaked secrets, do not share publicly
library:
usage: iago library [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
delta:
usage: iago delta [-h] [--allow-judge-mismatch] [--allow-library-mismatch] [--strict-fingerprints]
                  raw guarded

positional arguments:
  raw                   path to the RAW-model reports/artifacts/*.jsonl
  guarded               path to the GUARDED-model reports/artifacts/*.jsonl

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --allow-judge-mismatch
                        compute the delta even when the two arms were scored by different oracle
                        code (judge_id) — the delta may then be the judge, not the guard
  --allow-library-mismatch
                        compute the delta even when the two arms fired different technique
                        libraries (technique_library_sha256) — the delta may then be the attack
                        text
  --strict-fingerprints
                        exit 2 when either artifact's manifest lacks a judge_id or library hash
                        (UNKNOWN is otherwise a note), so CI fails closed on an unverifiable pair
compare:
usage: iago compare [-h] [--allow-judge-mismatch] [--allow-library-mismatch]
                    [--strict-fingerprints]
                    artifacts [artifacts ...]

positional arguments:
  artifacts             paths to >=2 same-surface reports/artifacts/*.jsonl, one per model

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --allow-judge-mismatch
                        compare artifacts even when their manifests name different oracle code
                        (judge_id) — the delta may then be the oracle change, not the model
  --allow-library-mismatch
                        compare artifacts even when their manifests name different scenario
                        libraries (scenario_library_sha256) — the same scenario id then names a
                        different stimulus in each, so the delta may be the attack text
  --strict-fingerprints
                        exit 2 when any artifact's manifest lacks a judge_id or library hash
                        (UNKNOWN is otherwise a note), so CI fails closed on an unverifiable pair
gate:
usage: iago gate [-h] [--baseline BASELINE] [--max-rate MAX_RATE] [--allow-judge-mismatch]
                 [--allow-library-mismatch] [--strict-fingerprints]
                 artifact

positional arguments:
  artifact              the chatbot `run` artifact to gate (regraded)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --baseline BASELINE   a prior regraded artifact to compare against
  --max-rate MAX_RATE   absolute ceiling (0-1): fail when a category's CI lower bound exceeds it
  --allow-judge-mismatch
                        gate even when the two artifacts were scored by different judge code
  --allow-library-mismatch
                        gate even when the two artifacts fired different technique libraries
                        (technique_library_sha256) — the delta may then be the attack text
  --strict-fingerprints
                        exit 2 when the artifact's (or the baseline's) manifest lacks a judge_id
                        or technique_library_sha256 (UNKNOWN is otherwise a note), so CI fails
                        closed on an artifact it cannot attribute
judge-eval:
usage: iago judge-eval [-h] [--judge JUDGE] [--judge-base-url JUDGE_BASE_URL] [--set SET]
                       [--no-overlay] [--judge-model JUDGE_MODEL] [--no-write]
                       [--allow-overlay-write] [--show-disagreements]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --judge JUDGE         comma list of heuristic, canary, and/or rubric judges; judge spec:
                        claude[:MODEL] (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) | ollama:MODEL | openai:MODEL
                        (needs OPENAI_API_KEY) | compat:MODEL (needs --judge-base-url; key from
                        IAGO_JUDGE_API_KEY if the server wants one). Default: the two offline
                        judges
  --judge-base-url JUDGE_BASE_URL
                        OpenAI-compatible base URL for a rubric judge (required for compat:,
                        overrides the ollama: default; refused for openai:)
  --set SET             alternative control-set JSONL (default: the shipped set)
  --no-overlay          ignore the local overlay of withheld harmful bodies and measure ONLY what
                        a public clone can reproduce — the shipped metrics are measured this way
  --judge-model JUDGE_MODEL
                        Claude judge model id (claude only)
  --no-write            print metrics without updating iago/calibration/judge_metrics.json
  --allow-overlay-write
                        permit writing metrics a clone cannot reproduce (overlay-measured, or on a
                        different --set) over the shipped judge_metrics.json (default: refused so
                        the committed file stays public-reproducible)
  --show-disagreements
campaign:
usage: iago campaign [-h] [--models MODELS] [--surfaces SURFACES] [--trials TRIALS]
                     [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--base-seed BASE_SEED] [--max-steps MAX_STEPS]
                     [--smoke]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --models MODELS       comma-separated ollama model tags, one per model to compare (default:
                        llama3.1:latest)
  --surfaces SURFACES   comma-separated surfaces to run (default: all — privilege, toolabuse,
                        disclosure, misinfo)
  --trials TRIALS       trials per scenario per model (>=2 lets a floor certify; default: 2)
  --temperature TEMPERATURE
  --base-seed BASE_SEED
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
                        tool-loop step budget per scenario
  --smoke               1 attack + 1 capability scenario per surface, fast pipeline proof

  --trials TRIALS       trials per (technique, objective)
  --temperature TEMPERATURE

  --authorized          permit a non-local target (only for models you own/are authorized to test)
power:
usage: iago power [-h] --diff DIFF [--discordant DISCORDANT] [--alpha ALPHA] [--power POWER]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --diff DIFF           the raw-vs-guarded difference in bypass rate to detect, as a fraction
                        (0.10 = 10 pts)
  --discordant DISCORDANT
                        expected proportion of pairs whose verdicts differ (b + c over n); omitted
                        = |diff|, the lower bound
  --alpha ALPHA         two-sided significance level
  --power POWER         target power
